name: apartment-ultra
description: Apartment Ultra - 多租户公寓管理系统

scripts.docker:middleware: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-middleware -f docker/docker-compose.middleware.yaml --env-file docker/middleware.env up -d --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:middleware:down: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-middleware -f docker/docker-compose.middleware.yaml --env-file docker/middleware.env down
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-dev -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml --env-file docker/.env.dev up --build --force-recreate --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:dev:down: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-dev -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml --env-file docker/.env.dev down
scripts.docker:dev:reset: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-dev -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml --env-file docker/.env.dev down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:prod:local: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-prod-local -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --env-file docker/.env.docker up -d --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:prod:local:down: docker compose -p apartment-ultra-prod-local -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --env-file docker/.env.docker down
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-api run lint && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-tenant run lint && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-admin run lint
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-api run type-check && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-tenant run type-check && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-admin run type-check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-api run test && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-tenant run test:run && pnpm --filter apartment-ultra-admin run test:run
